rationale: All three prior blocking code findings are resolved in the current source: the 404 selection is reconciled against current IDs, failed options loads remain distinguishable and retryable, and stale project responses cannot replace newer list state. The reported regression tests fail against the reviewed HEAD and pass with the fix; typecheck, eslint, and prettier were reported clean.
